scope: Owned pitfall handler and its separately traced delayed five-damage message. Native floor transition and HP logic retained; ordinary discovery/progression and death branches remain separate.

entries.review: Independent T2 Japanese reading preserves the pitfall, avoided harm and exact five-point damage acknowledgement. Complete static one-line messages. The delayed damage message belongs to the floor-transition caller, not the trap handler itself.
